shortBio.en: Blur guitar; noise/feedback anti-virtuoso chops; exits before Think Tank.
shortBio.zh: Blur 吉他；噪声/反馈反炫技切分；Think Tank 前离队。

body.en:
Born 1969. Guitar vocabulary—noise, feedback, falling-apart texture—anchors Blur’s art-school side. Leaves before Think Tank (2003); returns on later reunions.

Song 2 crunch and Coffee & TV melodic lead are dual citations.
body.zh:
1969 年生。吉他语汇——噪声、反馈、散架纹理——撑住 Blur 艺术学院一面。Think Tank（2003）前离队；后期重聚回归。

Song 2 失真与 Coffee & TV 旋律主音是双引用。
